notice: Simulated estimate — not a real-world revenue guarantee
limitations: Recommendations only; no ad budgets are changed.
Uncertainty is not quantified. Forecast differences are estimates, not observed gains.
Platform attribution can overlap. Summed attributed revenue is not unique store sales.
Observational predictions do not establish causal returns from reallocating spend.
The representative training-day mix repeats unchanged each day; no campaign selection, audience interaction, cross-platform substitution or new-campaign effect is modeled.
Supported spend uses platform-wide training bounds; context-specific support and future seasonality are not independently validated. Review campaign execution separately.
Monotonicity and diminishing returns are planning assumptions. Adjusted curves are conservative relative to sampled raw outputs, not statistical lower confidence bounds.
